status: Implemented; fresh live fog acceptance pending
implementation: All proposal sources pass measured diameter, annular-band geometry and sampled-ring color checks before arbitration.
Named appearance compatibility constrains both old-position presence and the inferred mover destination; identity still requires a single unambiguous departure.
Unexplained extras preserve uncertainty and cannot update the background, including extras appearing during acquisition.
Local anchor searches use the same verifier and widen immediately on missing or ambiguous evidence; periodic full-board audits run independently of movement confirmation.
Whole-board background adaptation is disabled on local-only observations.

recorded_regression.scope: Saved-camera open-loop regression. Changed tracker outputs do not generate new Foundry redraws. Live fog acceptance remains required.

cpu.scope:
Alternate old/new stationary engine frames, then time a departed-ring search.

Each engine sees the same exact saved frames and metadata in the same order.
The separate departure probe calls only the detectors using unchanged starting
positions and a later real camera frame; it measures immediate wide fallback,
not movement accuracy or end-to-end latency.

avatar_template_probe.method: Manually cropped rendered-avatar image compared with candidate color patterns in three nearby saved frames.
avatar_template_probe.scope: One avatar and lighting setup; production catalog, threshold and occlusion handling remain unvalidated.

live_acceptance: Restart source app, keep fog and avatars visible, bind six physical rings, and move one mini at a time. Saved replay does not generate new feedback/redraws for newly detected moves.
